title: Resolution to update groups getting Council discretionary funding
summary: This resolution approves new and changed designations of organizations receiving discretionary funding under the city's Fiscal 2025, 2026 and 2027 expense budgets, covering programs like aging, youth, anti-poverty and cultural services. It also approves amended funding purposes for some groups under the Fiscal 2026 and 2027 budgets. Details of each organization and funding amount appear in attached charts.
